repairDataContractResponse.purpose: Answer all five requested existing capability-library data domains; descriptive navigation only. No second model database, dispatcher, device writer, polling or admission gate.

fieldResponses.requestedField: canonical model/family and extension origin
fieldResponses.explanation: Use CONTROLLER-MODEL-COVERAGE.models by class/alias and nativeIdentityProjection for 18 shared OEM source classes. All 10 reviewed native extensions retain original selector fallback if frozen model lookup is null; projection never rewrites global identity.

fieldResponses.requestedField: physical-vs-virtual device source identity
fieldResponses.explanation: Original HID role classifier excludes virtual identity; actual standard source is provider-selected. input-host-frame-evidence.physicalIdentityCache is a diagnostic cache and explicitly physicalIdentitySampleBindingProven=false; do not join it to a frame as established device ownership.

fieldResponses.requestedField: exact interface, VID/PID, usage page/usage, container root, location
fieldResponses.explanation: Existing selected-source inventory records instanceId/interfacePath/baseContainerDeviceInstanceId/vendorId/productId/usagePage/usage/miCol/role/gameInput. Container/location must come from actual source or current owner record; a VID/PID or DMI hint alone is not an integrated-controller proof. MSI command preparation usage is not the main game interface.

fieldResponses.requestedField: generation and snapshot source
fieldResponses.explanation: Use InputCaptureGamepadSnapshot read topology/identity/power/context stamps; diagnostic physicalIdentitySampleBindingProven remains false. Never substitute exported old metadata for the current producer association.

domains.unknownHandlingPreserved: unrecognized family does not prohibit observed standard controller input; do not adopt virtual endpoint as physical

fieldResponses.requestedField: actual producer/source label
fieldResponses.explanation: inputSource and connectedMask feed bindStandardInput; supported aliases xinput/xinput-any-connected/msi-dinput. Optional OEM, motion or isolation absence cannot reject all observed standard input.

fieldResponses.requestedField: fresh read sequence and completion
fieldResponses.explanation: readAttemptSequence/readStartedTick/readCompletedTick/readContextStable are actual canonical API-read evidence. sourceForNewRead rejects replay of the old read; unchanged XInput packet or stationary buttons are not stale-read proof. No additional reader or per-frame logger is requested.

fieldResponses.requestedField: source/topology/power generation
fieldResponses.explanation: readPowerGeneration/readTopologyGeneration/readIdentityGeneration and MSI readMsiSourceRevision/readMsiModeGeneration must match current owner. readContinuityGeneration is diagnostic context, not a substitute for API read sequence.

fieldResponses.requestedField: source owner and current pretarget slots
fieldResponses.explanation: Use ticket host/power/intent with current Host epoch, source ownership and primarySlot/connectedMask; pointer or slot number alone does not prove the physical root. Keep the same-target full-neutral release valid when the source disappears.

domains.unknownHandlingPreserved: no family name or mode label substitutes fresh live sample

fieldResponses.requestedField: exact game collections permitted to hide

Role inventory is descriptive and does not itself authorize hiding all siblings or a composite root. Never hide a virtual source as the physical source.

fieldResponses.requestedField: game node refresh capability separated from simple source detection
fieldResponses.explanation: nativeForeground policy has MSI/ROG/GPD candidate profiles with board and actual VID/PID/topology checks. OneX/AYA lack this specialized native-foreground refresh route; retain standard virtual output and do not borrow GPD 045E:028E mutation.

fieldResponses.requestedField: known write prohibition and exact return/compensation recipe
fieldResponses.explanation: ROG PID_1B4C HID refresh remains mutation-prohibited. Return/compensation belongs to original owner and helper implementation, not model declaration. R5 tracks GPD native helper writer only; native first-hide ledger/OFF crash recovery remain incomplete.

fieldResponses.requestedField: external consumer observation if available

domains.unknownHandlingPreserved: not implemented stays unknown; no family-wide composite-root stop or blanket service kill

fieldResponses.requestedField: what physical signal/interface should return for each supported transport
fieldResponses.explanation: MSI managed 1902 DInput route has mode/visibility return duties to the actual recorded physical source; native 1901 and vendor command collections are separate roles. ROG uses its original current-source XInput OFF observation; GPD helper terminal receipt does not prove node enabled. OneX/AYA use only existing generic return duties until a source-specific physical protocol is verified.

fieldResponses.requestedField: exact owner release and helper retirement receipts
fieldResponses.explanation: Use persisted Origin parent/host birth identity, runId/hostInstanceId/epoch/transaction and exact native helper writer. Empty Host state or missing named Job alone is not a writer-quiet or responsibility-settlement proof. Do not clear foreign/inherited unknown ownership.

Later physical read or wake output is distinct evidence, not a rewrite of an expired OFF/switch request.

diagnosticSemantics.pauseMeaning: Diagnostic bits only, no new recovery or deadline authority. pauseReasonMask states sampled active gates; pauseReasonObservedMask states which gates were observed. A bit absent from the observed mask is UNKNOWN, not false. Earlier gates short-circuit SgWriterBlocked observation.
diagnosticSemantics.nullMeaning: No matching observation or no Host-mutex facts means null/unobserved, not a clear gate. pauseReasonMaskSeen is accumulated history, not necessarily current. Excluded/healthy point timestamps belong to the same request and observed power generation.
diagnosticSemantics.cleanupMeaning: Final cleanupEvidence is emitted only with Host facts for disabled persona; null on ON is not missing capability. checks/blockers/unknown are a cached, non-atomic, single-try snapshot; empty blockers alone is not physical return proof. Physical/game flags remain false.

conclusions.text: 拒绝发生在实体 XUSB 游戏节点的 disable 阶段；同会话五个虚拟切换本地 final 均 success，不能归因为总库拒绝 Win5 虚拟创建。
CONFIGRET 23(0x17)=CR_REMOVE_VETOED；disable flags 0x4=CM_DISABLE_UI_NOT_OK，PERSIST=0x8。helper exit6 与 CONFIGRET、异常 HRESULT 分属不同域。
HC 通用 XInput Hide/Unhide 后调用 USB CyclePort；YMCC GPD --game-xusb 对当前同 devnode 作 CM_Disable/Enable。二者 API 和目标处理层级不同，不能视作已等价移植。
21 个 GPD 设备类没有声明自己的 Hide/Unhide/CyclePort；045E:028E 在 HC ControllerManager 无匹配专用类时回落 XInputController。未发现 Win5 专属虚拟创建禁止条件。
Win5 2F24:0137/0135 FF00:0001 与固件门只涉及 OEM 背键。>=0x01.0x11 时静音 L4/R4/Gamepad legacy chords；读取循环仍独立启动，固件门不是虚拟目标准入。
HC Hide 不消费 CyclePort bool，随后仍通知 VisibilityChanged；PnPDetails 吞端口循环异常并返回 false。HC 界面状态不足以证明端口刷新或外部屏蔽成功。
